message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023**.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a statutory holiday that falls on a Friday or a Monday (or is observed on the adjacent day), giving you a three‑day break.  (If a holiday falls on a weekday, it does **not** create a long weekend.)

| Date(s) | Holiday | Notes / Province(s) |
|---------|---------|---------------------|
| **Jan 1–3** | New Year’s Day (observed Mon Jan 2) | Federal; all provinces |
| **Feb 18–20** | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan) | Family Day in Alberta & Saskatchewan is on Fri Feb 20 |
| **Feb 20–22** | Family Day (Ontario) | Family Day in Ontario is on Fri Mar 20 (see below) |
| **Mar 15–17** | St. Patrick’s Day (Newfoundland & Labrador) | Observed Fri Mar 17 |
| **Mar 18–20** | Family Day (Ontario) | Family Day in Ontario is on Fri Mar 20 |
| **Apr 5–7** | Good Friday | Federal & all provinces |
| **May 20–22** | Victoria Day | Federal & all provinces |
| **Aug 6–8** | Civic Holiday (most provinces) | First Monday in August |
| **Jul 1–3** | Canada Day (observed Mon Jul 3) | Federal; all provinces |
| **Sep 2–4** | Labour Day | Federal & all provinces |
| **Oct 7–9** | Thanksgiving | Federal & all provinces |
| **Nov 11–13** | Remembrance Day (observed Mon Nov 13) | Federal & all provinces |
| **Dec 23–25** | Christmas | Federal & all provinces |

### Quick Tips for Planning

1. **Check Province‑Specific Holidays** – Some provinces have additional holidays that can create extra long weekends (e.g., “St. Patricks Day” in Newfoundland & Labrador, “Family Day” in other provinces).  
2. **Observe vs. Actual Date** – If a holiday falls on a weekend, the *observed* day (usually the following Monday) is what creates the long weekend.  
3. **Travel & Accommodation** – Book early for the most popular long weekends (e.g., Canada Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas) as hotels and flights tend to fill up quickly.

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app or let me know if you’d like a more detailed breakdown by province!
